mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, title, content, is_read, created_at, target_type, target_id FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, is_push_enabled, created_at FROM notification_setting WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY type ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_setting ( user_id, type, is_push_enabled ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{type}, #{pushEnabled} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_push_enabled = VALUES(is_push_enabled)
